primitive: adds a basic solid: box, sphere, cylinder, cone
blob: adds smooth shapes that melt together into one organic body
part: adds a ready-made mechanical part (pegs, brackets) as a body
sketch: draws 2D lines and shapes on paper, to build solids from later
profile: draws the 2D cross-section outline a solid is made from
spline: a smooth curve through control points
plane: a flat construction plane to sketch on or cut with
import: brings in a mesh from a file
bodyfrombones: grows a body's flesh around a skeleton's bones
extrude: pulls a flat sketch straight up into a solid
revolve: spins a profile around an axis into a round solid (vase, bottle)
loft: makes a solid that blends between two or more different cross-sections
sweep: drags a cross-section along a path to make a tube or rail
boolean: subtracts / unions / intersects one solid with another
mirror: copies a body to the other side of a mirror plane
linearpattern: repeats a feature in a straight row
circularpattern: repeats a feature around a circle
shell: hollows a solid out, leaving thin walls and an open face
hole: drills a round hole through a body
chamfer: cuts a sharp edge or corner off flat at an angle
draft: tapers a body's walls at an angle (as for moulding)
trim: cuts a body along a plane and keeps one side
subdivide: smooths a blocky mesh by splitting its faces, sharp to smooth
remesh: rebuilds the surface into a fresh even mesh of polygons
detail: adds small surface details: rivets, panel lines, screws
stroke: adds a raised or carved line along the surface, like a brush stroke of clay
sculpt: pushes and pulls a soft surface by hand with sculpting tools
transform: moves, rotates or scales a body (gizmo with axis arrows)
lattice: deforms a body by moving the points of a cage around it
simpledeform: bends, twists or tapers a whole body
curvedeform: makes a body follow along a curve
moveface: pushes or pulls one face of a solid along its normal
edit:extrude: pulls selected mesh faces out into new geometry
edit:inset: makes a smaller face inside a face, with a border ring
edit:bevel: bevels selected mesh edges into narrow slanted faces
edit:loopcut: cuts a new edge loop all the way round a mesh
edit:bridge: joins two open edges / faces with new faces spanning the gap
edit:symmetrize: makes one half of a mesh match the other half across the middle
edit:dissolve: removes edges/vertices while keeping the surface closed
meshedit: direct mesh editing: select and move vertices, edges, faces
deleteface: deletes one face, leaving an open hole in the mesh
garment: makes clothing (a shirt etc.) that fits a body
fabric: turns a surface into soft draping cloth
padding: adds quilted padding / stuffing to clothing
pocket: sews a pocket with a flap onto clothing
hardware: adds clothing hardware: buckles, rings, rivets
wear: adds wear and tear to clothing: holes, frays, scuffs
wearer: sets the body (mannequin) that clothing is fitted on
fur: grows fur / hair strands over a surface
material: assigns a material (colour, roughness, metal) to a body
paint: paints colour onto a surface with a brush
facematerial: gives one face of a body its own material
skin: skin surface details: pores, freckles, spots
glow: makes part of a body emit light
uvproject: unwraps a body's surface flat into a UV map for textures
bind: binds a body's mesh to a skeleton's bones
shapekey: a morph target: a slider that blends a body between two shapes
shapekeyend: ends a shape key: the slider's far stop, the target shape
shapekeysplit: splits a shape key sculpted on both sides into a left and a right key
correctiveshapekey: a shape key that fixes bad bending where a joint bends (elbow, knee)
set: changes a setting/parameter on an existing feature
remove: removes a feature from the model
remedy: repairs a broken mesh (holes, bad faces)
fix: repairs a mesh: closes holes, removes loose bits, fixes normals
measure: measures a body: its size, or a point's position
distance: measures the distance between two points or bodies
symmetry: checks whether a body is the same on both sides
clearance: checks the gap (or overlap) between two bodies
topology: reports on the mesh's polygons: quads, poles, bad faces
section: cuts the model open on a plane to show its cross-section
flex: bends the model's joints to check how it deforms
match: compares the model with a reference picture
describe: writes a text description / report of the model
render: renders a picture of the model (a camera shot)
turnaround: renders the model from all round, as on a turntable
export: writes the model out to a mesh file
bake: bakes the model into game-ready files and texture maps
paintmaps: writes the painted textures out as image maps
pivot: sets the point a part turns about (its origin)
rebuild: recomputes the whole model from its feature history
